checkpoints.description: [1/2] Review the last 78 pushes: keep pathlib basename matching for non-recursive scope globs

impact_assessment.why: 17069a4 replaced PurePath.match for every scope pattern; a declaration like paths: ['*.py'] no longer covers scripts/a.py, so a valid commit is refused as outside scope even though the previous matcher accepted it.
impact_assessment.benefits: Only patterns with a whole ** segment use the recursive walker; ordinary globs keep their suffix matching and existing declarations stay valid.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: proof scope paths; dependency: stdlib pathlib/fnmatch; concurrency: none; state: verify_commit.py, tests, ADR, map
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first basename/suffix glob test, existing recursive and directory tests, full unit tier, root scan and gates
